facts.fact: PMJJBY is a one-year term life insurance cover, renewable every year, for death due to any cause
facts.quote: The scheme is a one-year cover term life insurance scheme, renewable from year to year, offering life insurance cover for death due to any cause.

facts.fact: Cover: Rs 2 lakh paid on the subscriber's death due to any cause
facts.quote: Rs.2 lakh is payable on a subscriber’s death due to any cause.
The premium payable is Rs.436/- per annum per subscriber.

facts.fact: The premium is auto-debited from the bank/post office account in one instalment
facts.quote: The premium will be deducted from the account holder’s bank / Post office account through ‘auto debit’ facility in one instalment
The cover shall be for one-year period stretching from 1st June to 31st May.

facts.fact: Pro-rata premium for first-time joiners: full Rs 436 for enrolment in June-August and Rs 342 in September-November
facts.quote: a) For enrolment in June, July and August – Full annual premium of Rs.436/- is payable. b) For enrolment in September, October, and November – pro rata premium of Rs. 342/- is payable

facts.fact: Pro-rata premium for first-time joiners: Rs 228 for enrolment in December-February and Rs 114 in March-May
facts.quote: c) For enrolment in December, January and February – pro rata premium of Rs. 228/- is payable. d) For enrolment in March, April and May – pro rata premium of Rs. 114/- is payable.

facts.fact: The full Rs 436 is payable at renewal
facts.quote: However, full year’s premium @ Rs 436/- is payable at the time of renewal under the scheme.

facts.fact: Entry: savings account holders aged 18 to 50, through one account only
facts.quote: All individual (single or joint) account holders of participating banks / Post office, in the age group of 18 to 50 years are entitled to join.

facts.fact: Once enrolled, cover can continue up to age 55 with annual renewal (no entry after 50)
facts.quote: On attaining age 55 years (age near birth day), subject to annual renewal up to that date (entry, however, will not be possible beyond the age of 50 years).

facts.fact: 30-day lien period: death other than by accident within 30 days of enrolment is not covered
facts.quote: insurance cover shall not be available for death (other than due to accident) occurring during the first 30 days from the date of enrolment into the scheme (lien period)

facts.fact: The premium was revised from Rs 330 to Rs 436 with effect from 1 June 2022
facts.quote: from Rs.330 to Rs.436 and from Rs.12 to Rs.20, respectively.

facts.fact: Enrolment is possible online through the Jan Suraksha Portal (besides the bank/post office branch)
facts.quote: The launch of the online Jan Suraksha Portal has made it possible for citizens to enrol conveniently without visiting bank branches or post offices.

facts.fact: The premium is still Rs 436 per year (PIB, 9 May 2026); no revision found up to Oct 2026
facts.quote: Premium: Rs.436/- per annum per member.

facts.fact: Enrol by visiting the bank branch, BC point (Bank Mitra) or bank website (net banking), or the post office for a post office savings account
facts.quote: Enrolments under the scheme can be done by visiting the branch/ BC point or website of the bank of the account holder or at the post office in case of post office savings bank account.

summary: DFS PMJJBY FAQ (24 Dec 2025) still shows Rs 436, Rs 2 lakh, pro-rata 342/228/114, 18-50 entry, cover to 55, 30-day lien; no revision found; all confirmed.
